name: HIM — The Haunting of Herobrine
description: A high-fidelity restoration of the Herobrine and Entity 303 creepypastas: the white-eyed figure staring from the fog, the red-eyed Entity 303, world anomalies (2x2 tunnels, leafless trees, sand pyramids, lit netherrack, cryptic signs), the golden totem that summons him — and the legendary battle between the two nemeses. Removed Herobrine.
